primitive: Core time needs an exact long-baseline high-resolution instant carrier with separate epoch parts and declared precision bounds.
evidence: crates/jet-codegen/src/Prelude/Core/Time.rs:652-655 stores DateTime as i64 seconds plus nanoseconds, while :677-681 accepts an i64 Unix-nanosecond count. A normal fractional instant works in the final run (highres_ns=123456789 roundtrip=1711726200123456789), but astronomy-astrophysics/claims.json:179-192 records the two-part long-epoch requirement.
